scenes.text: In 1977 we sent a message to the stars.
It carried a map to Earth. A greeting in 55 languages. A heartbeat.
We stopped listening for a reply in 1993.
It has been answering ever since.
We simply built the wrong kind of ears.
Follow Deep Space Logs for the next entry.
